name: Privacy Kill Dashboard
description:
Panel status for microphone mute, camera and microphone privacy locks (GNOME Privacy settings), and an optional soft VPN kill-switch.

When the kill-switch is armed and a VPN, WireGuard, or Tailscale connection drops, NetworkManager networking is disabled. This is a soft kill-switch, not a kernel firewall rule.

Uses NetworkManager D-Bus only. No telemetry and no remote network requests.
